name: openpixo/sprite-walk-side
title: Side-view walk animation
description: Step 2 of a side-view walk: animates a side-view walk sheet into one smooth looping walk facing right and one facing left, as transparent frames and an engine sprite sheet.

description_i18n.en: Step 2 of a side-view walk: animates a side-view walk sheet into one smooth looping walk facing right and one facing left, as transparent frames and an engine sprite sheet.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 侧视行走第 2 步：把侧视行走姿势图做成朝右、朝左各一段流畅循环的行走，导出透明帧和引擎精灵图。

recipe.whenToUse: Second step of a side-view walk: animate a walk sheet from sprite-walk-sheet-side into a looping walk facing right and facing left.
recipe.prompt:
A 2D game sprite sheet on a flat green screen: two copies of the same character side by side, seen from the side, the left one facing right and the right one facing left. Each copy does a walk cycle in place, as if on a treadmill that runs the way it faces: a classic side-view walk, legs swinging forward and back, which is left-right on screen. Each copy keeps its head, chest and hips pointing its own way for the whole clip: no copy turns toward the camera, twists, leans or rotates, and none moves out of its spot.

Arms swing opposite to the legs, the body bobs slightly up on each passing step, loose cloth sways a little. Both step in sync. The clip starts mid-stride with each copy's left foot forward, passes through the right foot forward halfway, and ends back in the exact starting pose: exactly one full stride. No copy ever stands still or brings its feet together.

Locked static camera, no zoom, no pan. Flat solid chroma-green background the whole time. Same design, colours and size in every frame. No new objects, no text, no shadows.
